name: Miva
description_en:
Miva is an ecommerce platform with documented storefront promotion, customer-specific product pricing and integrated payment workflows. Its official help center gives concrete administration steps for negotiated B2B prices and discount qualification.

This draft uses accessible help documentation rather than unverified summaries of the blocked marketing pages. It distinguishes merchant-configured product prices, payment-processing fees and the platform subscription, whose current quote was not established.
description_zh:
Miva 是电商平台，官方文档覆盖店铺促销、客户专属商品定价及集成支付流程。官方帮助中心提供协商式 B2B 价格与折扣资格的具体管理步骤。

本稿采用可访问帮助文档，不依赖受限营销页面的未核摘要，并区分商家设置的商品售价、支付处理费与平台订阅；当前平台报价未确认。

core_features.explanation_en: A price group can assign selected customers and products, with prices edited from either the customer or product record and API operations for ERP-managed values.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格组可指定客户和商品，从客户或商品记录编辑价格，也有供 ERP 管理价格的 API 操作。

core_features.explanation_en: Price groups define shopper eligibility, qualifying restrictions, priority, validity dates and exclusions against other groups.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格组定义买家资格、满足条件、优先级、有效日期以及与其他组的排除关系。

en: Test negotiated pricing with two customer accounts
zh: 使用两个客户账户测试协商价
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

pricing.billing_basis: Platform subscription unconfirmed (marketing pricing page 403). MivaPay guide: cards 2.99% + $0.49/transaction, PayPal/Venmo 3.49% + $0.49; product/eligibility conditions apply.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Platform subscription unconfirmed (marketing pricing page 403). MivaPay guide: cards 2.99% + $0.49/transaction, PayPal/Venmo 3.49% + $0.49; product/eligibility conditions apply.

official_check.scope: Public official pages read and bilingual draft cross-checked; no account, purchase, execution, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Test negotiated pricing with two customer accounts
sections.title_zh: 使用两个客户账户测试协商价
sections.en: The customer-specific guide starts at Marketing → Price Groups. Create a group, set eligibility/type, then separately assign customers and qualifying products before editing the price. Test the same SKU as the assigned customer, another signed-in customer and a guest to confirm scope. The ERP-related API documentation describes loading, setting and clearing these prices; no API call or customer account was actually used.
sections.zh: 客户专属定价指南从 Marketing → Price Groups 开始，创建组并设置资格与类型后，还需分别指派客户和适用商品，再编辑价格。可分别以指定客户、其他登录客户及访客查看同一 SKU，确认范围。ERP 相关 API 文档说明读取、设置和清除这些价格，但本次未实际调用 API 或使用客户账户。

sections.title_en: Check discount stacking and date boundaries
sections.title_zh: 检查折扣叠加与日期边界
sections.en: The overview distinguishes coupon-only, selected-customer, all-logged-in and all-shopper eligibility. Basket subtotal/quantity/weight restrictions, maximum discounts, priority and validity dates shape the result. Exclusions can prevent combinations in the same basket or on the same item. Evaluate a negotiated price together with a coupon and free-shipping promotion, including an ineligible basket and the expiry boundary. The test must reflect the store’s actual commercial policy.
sections.zh: 概述区分仅优惠码、指定客户、所有登录客户和所有访客资格。购物篮金额、数量、重量、最大折扣、优先级及有效日期共同影响结果；排除规则可限制同篮或同件叠加。应组合测试协商价、优惠码与免邮促销，并加入不合格购物篮和过期边界，按真实商务政策验收。

sections.title_en: Separate MivaPay processing fees from subscription fees
sections.title_zh: 区分 MivaPay 处理费与平台订阅费
sections.en: The official MivaPay guide, updated July 2026, lists card processing at 2.99% + $0.49 per transaction and PayPal/Venmo at 3.49% + $0.49. These are this payment product’s published rates, not a platform subscription or a universal rate for every gateway. The marketing pricing endpoint returned 403 and was not retried, so base subscription amounts, revenue thresholds, refunds, disputes and other applicable charges remain unconfirmed.
sections.zh: 2026 年 7 月更新的官方 MivaPay 指南列出卡支付每笔 2.99% + $0.49，PayPal/Venmo 每笔 3.49% + $0.49。这是该支付产品公布费率，不是平台订阅，也非所有网关通用费率。营销价格地址返回 403 后未重试，因此基础订阅、营收阈值、退款、争议及其他适用费用仍未确认。

sections.title_en: Check wallet prerequisites on every store domain
sections.title_zh: 逐店铺域名检查钱包前提
sections.en: MivaPay requires Miva 10.13.01 or later; its Apple Pay and Google Pay support requires Miva 26.01.01 or later. Apple Pay domain registration is per domain and cannot be shown standalone through MivaPay without the PayPal button. Google Pay requires both payment-settings and basket-template enablement. Device, browser, location and account eligibility still affect visibility. No checkout, domain registration, payment or recovery test was run.
sections.zh: MivaPay 要求 Miva 10.13.01 或更新版本，Apple Pay 与 Google Pay 支持要求 Miva 26.01.01 或更新版本。Apple Pay 需逐域名注册，通过 MivaPay 显示时不能脱离 PayPal 按钮单独展示；Google Pay 需要同时启用支付设置和购物篮模板。设备、浏览器、地区及账户资格仍会影响显示。未实际结账、注册域名、支付或测试恢复。

sections.en: Businesses with account-specific B2B prices or complex promotions can assess these documented controls. Prepare product/customer identifiers, discount policy and ERP ownership of price data before implementation. The examined help pages do not establish open-source rights, deployment licensing, all catalog capabilities or current subscription entitlements. Obtain those terms separately before committing to migration.
sections.zh: 有客户专属 B2B 价格或复杂促销的企业可评估这些控制。实施前应准备商品与客户标识、折扣政策，以及由 ERP 还是店铺管理价格的责任。已读帮助页未确认开源权利、部署许可、全部目录能力或当前订阅权限；承诺迁移前需另行取得条款。
